items.title: 今天只管可爱
items.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / ads-marketing.
Create one finished 3:4 vertical photographic paper-collage poster for an experimental visual-skills style showcase. This is a newly generated fictional demonstration, not a before/after or proof of preserving an uploaded photo.
Make a sophisticated publishable independent music / cultural magazine design: one clear photographic focal point, editorial Chinese typography, purposeful paper overlaps, tactile fibrous torn edges, fine analog print grain and shallow contact shadows. Balance visible hierarchy and breathing room. Photographic subject, not drawing, 3D cartoon or digital painting. Do not recycle a centered white outlined cutout on graph paper. Do not use the same title-at-top/photo-in-frame/bottom-caption template. No generic floating stars, no thick sticker bevels.
Specific design:
One photographic ginger kitten with blue eyes, pink nose, exactly two ears and two visible front paws, sitting naturally. Warm printed fur detail, plausible anatomy. Tomato-red paper background and oversized buttery-yellow irregular torn circular paper field rising from bottom left. Large kitten clipping lower right, huge playful black Chinese headline upper left with uneven baselines. Small lilac torn scrap holds the English at lower left. Exactly one short cobalt crayon loop. Thin cream torn edge around fur, soft contact shadow; no cartoon rendering or repeated icons.
Exact text only, verbatim, no additional text:
Chinese headline line 1: 今天
Chinese headline line 2: 只管可爱
Small English accent: SMALL PAWS / BIG MOOD
Render every Chinese character correctly and completely, readable at thumbnail size, all text safely inside the poster. Keep subject faces, eyes and key product details uncovered. No invented brands, dates, prices, signatures, watermarks, QR codes, URLs or calls to contact anyone. No scene mockup, wall, surrounding frame, side-by-side comparison or multi-panel sheet. Fill the image with the single finished poster.
